# LaTeX `\rowcolor` Command

The `\rowcolor` command is used to color entire rows in a table. It requires the **`colortbl`** package (or `xcolor` with the `table` option).

## Setup

```latex
\usepackage[table]{xcolor}
% or
\usepackage{colortbl}
```

---

## Basic Syntax

```latex
\rowcolor{color}
```

---

## Basic Example

```latex
\begin{tabular}{|l|l|l|}
    \hline
    \rowcolor{gray!30} Header 1 & Header 2 & Header 3 \\
    \hline
    \rowcolor{blue!20} Row 1    & Data     & Data     \\
    \rowcolor{green!20} Row 2   & Data     & Data     \\
    \rowcolor{red!20}  Row 3    & Data     & Data     \\
    \hline
\end{tabular}
```

---

## Alternating Row Colors

```latex
\usepackage[table]{xcolor}

% Define colors
\definecolor{oddrow}{RGB}{230, 240, 255}
\definecolor{evenrow}{RGB}{255, 255, 255}

\begin{tabular}{lll}
    \hline
    \rowcolor{gray!50} \textbf{Name} & \textbf{Age} & \textbf{City} \\
    \hline
    \rowcolor{oddrow}  Alice & 25 & New York  \\
    \rowcolor{evenrow} Bob   & 30 & London    \\
    \rowcolor{oddrow}  Carol & 28 & Paris     \\
    \rowcolor{evenrow} Dave  & 35 & Berlin    \\
    \hline
\end{tabular}
```

---

## Auto Alternating with `\rowcolors`

```latex
% \rowcolors{starting row}{odd color}{even color}
\rowcolors{2}{gray!15}{white}

\begin{tabular}{lll}
    \hline
    \rowcolor{gray!50}
    \textbf{Name} & \textbf{Age} & \textbf{City} \\
    \hline
    Alice & 25 & New York \\
    Bob   & 30 & London   \\
    Carol & 28 & Paris    \\
    Dave  & 35 & Berlin   \\
    \hline
\end{tabular}
```

---

## With `booktabs`

```latex
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage[table]{xcolor}

\begin{tabular}{lll}
    \toprule
    \rowcolor{blue!30}
    \textbf{Name} & \textbf{Value} & \textbf{Unit} \\
    \midrule
    \rowcolor{blue!10} Speed    & 100 & km/h \\
                       Distance & 200 & km   \\
    \rowcolor{blue!10} Time     & 2   & h    \\
    \bottomrule
\end{tabular}
```

---

## Common Issues & Tips

| Issue | Solution |
|-------|----------|
| Color bleeds past `\hline` | Use `\arrayrulecolor` or switch to `booktabs` |
| Doesn't work with `multirow` | Add `\rowcolor` to each spanned row |
| Conflicts with `\cellcolor` | `\cellcolor` overrides `\rowcolor` locally |
| Color in header only | Use `\rowcolor` on header row only |

---

## `\rowcolor` vs `\cellcolor` vs `\columncolor`

```latex
\rowcolor{red!20}        % Colors entire row
\cellcolor{blue!20}      % Colors single cell
\columncolor{green!20}   % Colors entire column (in preamble)
```
